title: Plaster and Block Adhesive
intro: Providing specialized bonding solutions that securely fix blocks, bricks, and plaster to walls and surfaces, these adhesives ensure strong adhesion, minimize cracking, deliver a smooth finish, and enhance the durability and longevity of construction projects—making them ideal for residential, commercial, and industrial applications.

products.name: Bronco® Master Plast
products.description: Bronco® Master Plast is a ready-to-use, polymer-modified cementitious plaster designed for superior bonding and smooth finish on internal and external walls. It offers excellent workability, crack resistance, and durability, eliminating the need for separate cement and sand mixing. Supplied in 40 kg bags with a 12-month shelf life.

products.name: Bronco® Master Plast S
products.description: Bronco® Master Plast S is a block/plaster adhesive from Ethios that provides strong bonding, minimal cracking, and a smooth, durable finish. Contact our technical team for the data sheet and application guidance.

products.name: Bronco® Block Bond
products.description: Bronco® Block Bond is a ready-to-use, high-strength polymer-modified adhesive for laying AAC blocks, fly ash bricks, and concrete blocks. It provides excellent adhesion, reduced shrinkage, and faster application compared to traditional mortar. Supplied in 40 kg bags with a 12-month shelf life.

products.name: Bronco® Block Fix
products.description: Bronco® Block Fix is a block/plaster adhesive from Ethios that provides strong bonding, minimal cracking, and a smooth, durable finish. Contact our technical team for the data sheet and application guidance.

products.name: Bronco® Zip-It
products.description: BRONCO® ZIP-IT is a high-performance plaster bonding agent specially formulated for smooth RCC and concrete surfaces. Its polymer-rich formulation eliminates the need for surface hacking, ensuring superior adhesion and easy application. Ideal for internal plastering jobs, it enhances mechanical and chemical bonding with a single coat.

products.name: Weber Blokfix
products.description: Weber Blokfix is a ready-to-mix, self-curing AAC block adhesive designed for high bonding strength and quick wall construction. Ideal for AAC, CLC, and concrete blocks, it ensures superior adhesion, minimal shrinkage, and crack-free finishes with a 4mm application. Perfect for fast, durable masonry work with consistent quality.

products.name: Weber Blokset
products.description: Weber Blokset is a ready-to-mix, self-curing thin bed block adhesive designed for AAC, CLC, hollow, and concrete blocks. With superior bonding strength, minimized shrinkage, and compliance with ASTM C1660-09, it ensures fast, precise, and durable wall construction. Ideal for eco-friendly and water-saving masonry applications.
